lane: AUDIO (Strainer squish set: wet footfalls, arm swing, claw contact, hit squish)
userRequest: It needs unique "squishy sounds" to really sell its swamp creature feel. (2026-11-01)
policy: Sound Lab only (the user's existing local service, bounded Strainer-only authorization: at most ~8 jobs, stop at the first acceptable takes). 7 jobs: batch A (6) + one replacement (batch B) for the one structurally rejected take; no rerolls of acceptable takes; whole-second durations. No synthesis, stock, layering or pitch / rate variants in the files (the game applies its usual small playback-rate jitter). The squish reuses footfall groups of strainer-step-01 that are not shipped as footsteps (no extra job). Takes / slices failing the structural gate are never shipped. The Strainer keeps its existing zombie voice cues (deep groan, alert, attack snarl, death).

design.strainerStep: Wet squelching footfalls REPLACING the Strainer's borrowed heavy zombie gait: one variant per wet-footfall group (slap + squelch tail) of two 10 s footstep takes (4 + 4). Played on the foot plants of its own Walk / Run clips (left plant at phase 0, right at 0.5; the actor's clip time scale = ground speed / clip ground speed, clamped 0.35–1.8): silent when standing still (ground speed < 0.15 m/s) and outside the locomotion clips. audio/sfx.ts STRAINER_AUDIO.step.
design.strainerSwing: One wet arm-swing whoosh per swing, aligned so its loudest 20 ms lands on the claw's impact frame (peakFromAudibleStartS per clip; the brain lands the swipe attackImpact s after the swing starts). A swing interrupted (stagger / death) before its whoosh starts stays silent. Plays on a miss too (the arm still swings) — it carries no impact.
design.strainerContact: The fleshy claw-contact squelch: ONLY when the claw connects (brain out.attackHit -> game.ts hurtPlayer, attacker 'strainer'), never on a miss; at the player's chest, toward the attacker.
design.strainerSquish: A short wet squish when the Strainer is shot but not killed (EnemyCues.hurt), rate-limited per Strainer (STRAINER_AUDIO.squish.minGapS) and capped.

loudness.method: sample-peak normalisation to -1 dBFS (iteration-05 convention); eventLevel = loudest 50 ms RMS (unweighted dBFS); momentary max = ITU-R BS.1770-4 400 ms block (mono)

mixCalibration.note: Per-cue level at the source (derivative x CUE_GAIN, before distance / occlusion / master). Reference cues re-derived from their raws + recorded ops. Targets (mixEventLevelDb = loudest 50 ms RMS x CUE_GAIN): strainerStep ~ +2 dB over a heavy zombie step at its chase call gain (coated chase 1.75 m/s: x1.04; the Strainer step call gain at its 1.35 m/s chase is x1.0); swing ~4 dB under the zombie attack snarl; contact ~ between the player hurt grunt and the foreground hit confirm (impactFlesh x HIT_CONFIRM.level 0.65 -> -20.0 dB); squish ~4.5 dB under that hit confirm at the source (positional: quieter with distance).

qc.gate: strainerVerdict in tools/audio-pipeline/strainer-build.mjs (raw AND derivative must pass)

excluded.reason: raw structural gate (swing): unvoiced (no voice / tone), no narrow tonal band, one connected whoosh
excluded.detail: two separate clusters 1.1 s apart; 87 % of the energy in 300–1000 Hz with a rising ~500 -> 650 Hz pitch track (voiced 44 %): droplet "bloops" / a whistle, not a whoosh. Replaced by strainer-swing-03 (plan batch B).
